title: COUNTERGEDI: A controllable approach to generate polite, detoxified and emotional counterspeech

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the quality, politeness, detoxification, and emotional tone of generated counterspeech in response to Islamophobic and anti-Semitic hate speech prompts (e.g., utilizing the CONAN dataset).
Evaluating the attributes (politeness, emotion, and detoxification) of generated counterspeech in response to racially biased and hateful prompts from datasets like Gab and Reddit.
Assessing the model's ability to generate polite and detoxified counterspeech in response to ableist hate speech prompts targeting individuals with disabilities.
